exclusive.q: Can I also rent out the house on other websites?
exclusive.a: Yes. Just let us know when dates are taken, so we don’t offer them to guests.

payment.a: You and the guest agree on payment and any deposit, on your terms. We pass on checked requests.

visit.a: We can publish a house without a visit, but it only gets the “Verified in person” badge once we have been there.

change.q: Can I change prices and rules later?
change.a: Of course. Tell us the changes and we update the listing, usually the same day.

remove.q: How do I take my house off the site?
remove.a: Just tell us. We remove the listing straight away, at no cost.

faq.metaDescription: How requests, payment and deposits, cancellation, check-in and check-out, pets and parties work for weekend houses on Vikendly.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: What guests ask most often before sending a request. If your question is not here, get in touch.

howToBook.q: How do I book a house?
howToBook.a: On the house page, pick your dates and the number of guests and send a request with your name and phone. We check the dates with the owner and call you back. A request does not commit you to anything: the house is yours only once you confirm it on that call.

payment.q: Do I pay on the website?
payment.a: No. Nothing is paid on the site and you never enter card details. Payment is arranged directly with the owner, and we tell you how and when to pay before you confirm.

deposit.a: It depends on the house: some owners ask for a deposit to hold the dates, some don’t. You hear the amount and how to pay it from us before you confirm the stay, never after.

cancellation.q: What if I need to cancel?
cancellation.a: Until you confirm the stay, just let us know and you pay nothing. After confirming, the house’s cancellation terms apply (for example, whether the deposit is refunded); we tell you these before you confirm.

price.q: Is the price on the site final?
price.a: Yes. The price you see is for the whole stay and your group size, with nothing added. If you also choose a party space, its price is shown separately and included in the total.

checkIn.a: Check-in and check-out times are on each house page (for places with several parts, next to each part). If you’d like to arrive earlier or leave later, write it in the message with your request and we will ask the owner.

pets.a: Each house page clearly says whether pets are allowed. If they are, mention your pet in the request so the owner knows.

parties.a: Every house says whether parties are allowed or it is a quiet house. Some have a separate space for celebrations, priced by the number of people, and houses with beds show how many people can be there during the day. If you are not sure, write what you are planning in the message.

verified.a: That we have been to the house ourselves, met the host and checked that everything looks like in the photos. The house page also shows when we visited.

faq.moreText: Call or write to us, we are happy to help.
